testimonials.heading: Trusted by
testimonials.subtext: Real experiences from real patients across Chhattisgarh — because trust is built one family at a time.

items.name: Sunita Agarwal
items.text: MGPL has been our family's go-to lab for years. The staff is incredibly courteous, reports are always accurate, and the home collection service is a true blessing — especially for my elderly mother-in-law.

items.name: Rajesh Kumar Singh
items.text: Got my HbA1c and fasting glucose done here. The report was ready within 5 hours and shared on WhatsApp. The doctor consultation after the report was an unexpected bonus. Highly recommend.

items.name: Priya Mehta
items.text: I was anxious about my thyroid results, but the staff was so warm and reassuring. The pathologist called personally to explain the values. That kind of care is rare today.

items.name: Anil Sharma
items.text: Booked for my father — 78 years old — via home collection. The phlebotomist was gentle, professional, and on time. Reports were accurate and shared digitally. Superb service.

items.name: Nandini Tiwari
items.text: Diagnosed early with iron deficiency thanks to MGPL's comprehensive iron panel suggestion. The team here thinks about your health holistically. I'm truly grateful.

items.name: Mohit Verma
items.text: Best diagnostics in the city. Clean facility, courteous staff, quick results. The digital reports make it effortless to share with multiple doctors. Will always return here.
